setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_filtered_sales (region text COLLATE "C", sales_day date, is_return bool, amount int4, units int2)

INSERT INTO bench_filtered_sales SELECT CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'region-' || i % 16 END, CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE date '2026-01-01' + (i / 16) % 7 END, CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i / 112) % 2 = 0 END, CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 OR i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i % 10001 - 5000 END, CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i % 101 - 50)::int2 END FROM generate_series(1, 250000) g(i)
accel_query_sql: SELECT region, sales_day, is_return, sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 3000 OR amount IN (7,11,NULL)) AS sp, avg(amount) FILTER (WHERE amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 3000 OR amount IN (7,11,NULL)) AS ap, sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT (amount >= -1000 AND amount <= 1000)) AS sn, avg(amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT (amount >= -1000 AND amount <= 1000)) AS an, sum(units) FILTER (WHERE amount IN (-5000,0,5000,NULL)) AS su, avg(units) FILTER (WHERE amount IN (-5000,0,5000,NULL)) AS au, count(*) AS n FROM bench_filtered_sales WHERE amount < -2000 OR amount > 2000 GROUP BY region, sales_day, is_return
